check_worker_qualification: check if a worker meets all required qualifications for a given task run
validate_qualification_dict: validate a qualification dictionary ensuring all required keys and correct comparator values
create_qualification_dict: create a validated qualification dictionary with a name, comparator, value, and applicable providers
find_or_create_qualification: find an existing qualification by name in the database or create a new one if missing
review_qualification_comparators: review the supported qualification comparators including exists, greater, less, and in_list operations
